main.description: The SSH host keys a provisioned VM reported about itself, after proving it holds the ed25519 one over the provisioning token the bidder issued it. Written by the bidder in its own repo and carried in a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.event envelope (receipt + payload strongRefs + the bidder's inline signature). A requester trusts exactly these keys as the guest's known host keys; nothing scans the guest for them.

observedAt.description: When the bidder accepted the guest's report.

type.description: The SSH key type, as the first field of a known_hosts line.

publicKey.description: The base64 key blob, as the second field of a known_hosts line.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the key blob, as ssh-keygen -l prints it (SHA256:...).
